decisions.reason: As a close-to-core formwork profile line with several models, it still fits the firm's modular system business and is worth retaining, although its later lack of web visibility raises some doubt about standalone traction.

This automation-oriented flow-control offer remains strategically aligned with the firm's push toward more automated factories, and it can plausibly be kept as a low-cost option even if it is no longer prominently marketed.

After several years with limited visibility and overlap with other magnetic formwork items, the value of keeping this magnet block as a separate offer now looks too uncertain to justify continued attention.
Magnetic formwork strips appear to be one of the stronger and more committed launches in this group, so management would still keep this core-adjacent option open rather than exit now.

Because this magnetic formwork component was weakly presented from the start and sits in an overlapping product cluster that has already been pruned once, management would now reallocate resources away from it.
